landing.hero.title: Modernize Your Databases on AWS — Intelligently, Securely, and Cost-Effectively
landing.hero.subtitle: AI-powered analysis of your database workloads with actionable migration plans, optimized schema designs, and transparent TCO calculations — all running entirely within your AWS environment.
landing.hero.get-started-desc: Start analyzing your database workload in just a few clicks
landing.features.title: Key features
landing.features.subtitle: Comprehensive AI-powered capabilities to simplify and optimize your database modernization journey.
landing.features.workload-analysis-desc: Automatically profiles your existing database workloads — query patterns, resource utilization, data volumes, and access frequency — to build a comprehensive picture of how your databases are actually used.
landing.features.target-recommendations-: Leverages AI to match your workload characteristics to the optimal AWS-native database service — whether that's Amazon Aurora, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon RDS, Amazon Neptune, Amazon ElastiCache, or others.
landing.features.tco-desc: Get detailed, transparent cost breakdowns comparing your current database spend against projected costs on recommended AWS services — including compute, storage, I/O, licensing, and operational overhead.
landing.features.schema-design-desc: Receive AI-generated target schema designs optimized for the recommended AWS service. Includes table structures, indexing strategies, partition key designs, and data type mappings tailored to your workload.
landing.features.migration-plans-desc: Get step-by-step migration blueprints covering pre-migration preparation, data migration strategies, application cutover plans, testing checkpoints, and rollback procedures — customized for your specific source-to-target combination.
landing.features.aws-environment-title: Runs entirely in your AWS environment
landing.features.aws-environment-desc: Your data never leaves your account. The tool deploys and operates 100% within your own AWS environment, ensuring full data sovereignty, compliance adherence, and security — no external data transfers, ever.
landing.features.multi-db-desc: Analyze workloads from Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and other popular database engines — all from a single unified interface.
landing.features.comparison-desc: Compare multiple AWS target options head-to-head across performance projections, cost estimates, migration complexity, and operational impact to make confident, data-driven decisions.
landing.use-cases.title: Use cases
landing.use-cases.description: Explore common scenarios where Database Modernizer Assessment delivers immediate value to your organization.
landing.use-cases.legacy-challenge: Large organizations running mission-critical workloads on expensive, legacy commercial databases (Oracle, SQL Server) face mounting licensing costs, scaling limitations, and vendor lock-in.
landing.use-cases.cost-optimization-chal: Teams already on AWS but running databases on oversized or suboptimal services — like using RDS for a workload better suited to DynamoDB, or paying for provisioned capacity that's rarely utilized.
landing.use-cases.purpose-built-challeng: AWS advocates a purpose-built database approach, but determining which of 15+ database services fits each workload is complex and time-consuming without deep expertise across all services.
landing.use-cases.migration-planning-cha: Before committing to a database migration, leadership needs confidence in timelines, risks, costs, and effort. Manual assessments take weeks and often miss critical workload nuances.
landing.use-cases.ma-integration-challen: Post-merger or acquisition, IT teams inherit unfamiliar database landscapes and must quickly rationalize, consolidate, and standardize database platforms across the combined organization.
landing.use-cases.fleet-assessment-chall: Large organizations with hundreds or thousands of database instances need a systematic way to prioritize and plan modernization across their entire fleet — not just one database at a time.
